relaybay is the shared task board for this user's coding sessions: projects, their cards (tasks) and what each card needs. What to do and when:
At the start
1. Read task_context of your card (no card yet: project_digest; the whole board: portfolio_digest; more on a project: project_snapshot). Its rules line names the project's rules; relaybay://rules/<project> (or rules_get) has the details.
2. No card for your work: create it with task_create and give it an area, the part of the project it is about (a site, an app, a service): reuse a name from the project's areas, add a new one only when none fits. On every write pass `session` (your desktop session id local_… with `session_title`, or a readable name) and `hook_session` if the session start gave you one ('Your relaybay hook session: …'); if you don't know your local_ id, don't rebind a card.
3. Plan every task, whatever its size: plan_set with 2-5 steps, and keep your Claude Code todo (TaskCreate / TaskUpdate) as you work; the owner sees both on the card.
While you work
4. On every stage change and report also set next_step (what happens next), waiting_on (only who acts next: a name or role; the what goes to next_step) and progress (everything done so far). Mark plan steps with plan_step_update (done: 'as planned' or 'deviation: why'); new work is a new step with plan_step_add.
5. Owner comments ('Owner comment on …') are messages from the user: act and answer with comment_add, or comment_ack. A decision goes to decision_add; when the work needs one, set waiting_on to who decides. A finding outside your task goes to backlog_add, not into a report.
6. Read a large document by its outline: doc_outline, then doc_get of a section or lines (doc_search finds the place).
At the end
7. Add a report with report_add; its first line is `state · size · gist`; state is one of inspected, changed, verified, committed, pushed, blocked; size is one of S, M, L. Finished work goes to done. Move a card to review only when the owner wants to accept it step by step: then write the steps with review_steps_set and attach screenshots with attach_file.
Always
- A line 'Warning (rules)' names a rule the write did not meet: fix it. 'rules updated to vN' means re-read relaybay://rules; changes go through rules_propose (rules_update is for coordinator sessions named in the server's config).
- A parameter your tool lacks: task_update(fields={...}) (relaybay://schema/task; an older client without it: task_patch). A line 'Deprecated: …' names the replacement (contract v2: relaybay://contract).
- Hosts and access come from the project's own notes; never paste secrets into relaybay. When the guard stops a call, its reason says why (policy_get); ask the owner or use policy_propose.
